customer: Hi, i sold my minivan to Northwind since were going down to one car, but i think my auto payment went thru to the bank right after yall paid off the loan. Do i get that money back or did it go to you? Im in Brevin if that matters.
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on simplifying to one car! When your lender receives both our payoff and one of your regular payments, the extra amount belongs to you, and your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward overpayments, so if the refund doesn't arrive, please contact your lender directly.
